title: De schokkende voordelen van minder luchtvervuiling: een voorbeeld uit Griekenland

human_wellbeing_impact.evidence: het aantal winterse ziekenhuisopnames wegens hartproblemen bij de belangrijkste ziekenhuizen in de regio met 22 tot 42 procent terug

evidence_level.evidence: Tussen 2011 en 2021 daalde de hoeveelheid zwaveldioxide in de winter met meer dan 90 procent. Ook de concentratie fijnstof nam af. Tegelijkertijd liep het aantal winterse ziekenhuisopnames wegens hartproblemen bij de belangrijkste ziekenhuizen in de regio met 22 tot 42 procent terug.

change_durability.evidence: Mijnen gingen dicht, centrales werden gesloten en de luchtvervuiling nam sterk af.

human_thriving_analysis.dominant_subject: reduction in air pollution leading to fewer heart hospitalizations

title: London’s Ultra Low Emission Zone cleaned up the city’s air. Then children’s lungs got bigger

human_wellbeing_impact.evidence: The share of Londin children with clinically impaired lung function also fell significantly, from 14%, or one in 7, before the ULEZ, to 9%, or one in 11.

justice_rights_impact.evidence: At the end of 2020, a London coroner made history by ruling that air pollution, along with severe asthma, were the causes of death for nine-year-old Ella Kissi-Debrah, who died in 2013.

evidence_level.evidence: a major five-year study recently published in the Lancet Public Health journal

benefit_distribution.evidence: The study tracked the lung development of more than 3,400 children between the ages of 6 and 9, in both London and a comparison site of Luton

change_durability.evidence: after five years of the ULEZ, those children’s lungs have improved

human_thriving_analysis.dominant_subject: London's Ultra Low Emission Zone improving children's lung growth

title: Celebrated at birth, pushed into sex work

human_wellbeing_impact.evidence: Her elder daughter works with an NGO and is preparing to write the police exam, while her younger daughter is preparing for medical entrance tests in Indore.

social_cohesion_impact.evidence: In Sagargram, a group of mostly college-going youth formed a committee about four years ago. Within a year, they were able to stop sex work and liquor inside their village.

justice_rights_impact.evidence: Saniya says she encouraged a friend, who was being pressured by her family to get into sex work, to fight back. ... My friend fought with her parents, and they eventually relented. She is now continuing her studies.

evidence_level.evidence: Within a year, they were able to stop sex work and liquor inside their village.

benefit_distribution.evidence: NGOs have been running learning centres for children of the community so that they can resist their families’ push when the time comes.

change_durability.evidence: In Sagargram, a group of mostly college-going youth formed a committee about four years ago. Within a year, they were able to stop sex work and liquor inside their village.

title: Unifesp identifica resíduo compatível com sangue no antigo DOI-Codi/SP

human_wellbeing_impact.evidence: Os resultados obtidos em uma antiga enfermaria e em salas de interrogatório levaram à identificação de resíduos hemáticos.

social_cohesion_impact.evidence: A pesquisa integra um projeto interinstitucional coordenado por pesquisadores da Unifesp, da Universidade Estadual de Campinas (Unicamp) e da Universidade Federal de Minas Gerais (UFMG), com participação da UFSC e da USP.

justice_rights_impact.evidence: Pesquisadores identificaram resíduos compatíveis com sangue em áreas do antigo DOI-Codi de São Paulo, um dos principais centros de repressão da ditadura militar brasileira.

evidence_level.evidence: Em uma das amostras, coletada em uma antiga sala de interrogatório, a sala 7, um teste confirmatório apresentou resultado positivo para sangue humano.

benefit_distribution.evidence: A primeira etapa do projeto de pesquisa, realizada em 2022, utilizou radar de penetração no solo e escaneamento tridimensional do complexo. Em agosto de 2023, foram conduzidas escavações, prospecção nas paredes e nos pisos, análises forenses e atividades abertas ao público.

change_durability.evidence: A pesquisa integra um projeto interinstitucional coordenado por pesquisadores da Unifesp, da Universidade Estadual de Campinas (Unicamp) e da Universidade Federal de Minas Gerais (UFMG), com participação da UFSC e da USP.

human_thriving_analysis.dominant_subject: forensic identification of blood residue and a calendar at the former DOI-Codi/SP torture center
